scalars.scalar_value: Four (4) years of experience in the performance of semi-skilled building maintenance work related to a public aquarium or related facility as a Building Maintenance Worker; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

items.item_text: Must have a valid driver's license and have a driving record that is in accordance with local policies/procedures.
Overtime and weekends may be required.

Duties may require direct contact with children (defined as individuals under the age of 18); completion of the Child Abuse and Neglect Reporting Act (CANRA) training will be required. Must meet CANRA compliance requirement per California Child Abuse and Neglect Reporting Act (“CANRA,” Penal Code sections 11164-11174.4).Job offer is contingent upon satisfactory clearance based on Background Check results.

Four (4) years of experience in the performance of semi-skilled building maintenance work related to a public aquarium or related facility as a Building Maintenance Worker; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Proven skills and ability to repair and install electrical wiring and equipment; Experience installing, maintaining and repairing interior and exterior lighting systems; Proven skills and ability to perform carpentry tasks, drywall repair and painting, plumbing repair and installation; Knowledge of building refrigeration, hydronic and domestic water systems; Knowledge of heating, ventilation and air conditioning systems; Experience performing maintenance and repair on natural gas heaters
Demonstrated competency with and commitment to fostering fairness, respect, and inclusion in alignment with the Principles of Community.
Knowledge of related safety practices, use of proper tools, building codes, rules and regulations, particularly as they apply to UCSD.
Skills to prioritize work assignments to meet established department needs.
Proven ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing with all levels of the organization (faculty, staff and students).
Ability to work effectively in an environment of constantly changing priorities and work assignments.
Ability to delegate work in an orderly and systematic way.
Ability to read technical instruction manuals and drawings.
